name: editable-cell
title: Editable Cell
description: Inline-editable value with an async commit lifecycle — optimistic display, saving/saved/error status, revert on a rejected write, and a typed text/select/custom editor registry.

meta.whenToUse: Any optimistic inline edit of a single value — grid cells (focusMode=managed), record-page property lists, settings rows — where the write is async and can fail.
meta.whenNotToUse: Debounced save-as-you-type on a standing form field (AutoSaveInput), whole forms (Field), or plain click-to-edit with a synchronous commit and no status (FieldInline alone).
